purpose: Pressure-test the existing implementation against the independently pinned human semantic specification without repairing a detected mismatch.

checks.name: independent_semantic_entry
checks.meaning: The independently pinned semantic specification is internally well-typed.

checks.name: algebraic_conformance_bridge
checks.meaning: The existing premodular-category and tensor-identity-character data construct the independently pinned algebraic semantics.

checks.name: full_implementation_conformance_bridge
checks.meaning: The existing mainline cannot yet be checked against the full independent semantics.

root_blocker.independent_semantics_requires: A family X ↦ H₂(X), so each closed oriented smooth four-manifold has its own second-homology group.
root_blocker.existing_api_requires: One fixed type H2 : Type u with one AddCommGroup H2 instance for the entire presentation/evaluator construction.
root_blocker.eli5: The specification asks for the correct H₂ group separately for each manifold. The old API asks for one group once and reuses it everywhere. It is like a form asking for one address but receiving an address book indexed by person.

additional_observations.description: The failed dependency build also reports declarations using sorry in the public TwistedYetter presentation-agreement and diffeomorphism-invariance route, near lines 292 and 319.
additional_observations.interpretation: These warnings were not created or repaired by Stage 2 and must not be hidden by the H₂ blocker.

established: The existing algebraic input conforms to the independent algebraic semantics.
not_established: The existing presentation implementation supports arbitrary manifold-dependent H₂.
The existing role-aware evaluator conforms to the independent evaluator semantics.
The existing eight-move implementation conforms to the independently pinned move semantics.
The public TwistedYetter definition is a certified invariant for all closed oriented smooth four-manifolds.
formal_assessment.non_claim: This result does not show that the evaluator or Kirby-move mathematics is wrong; compilation stopped before those bridges were checked.

next_repair_obligation: Refactor the presentation/evaluation boundary to specialize at each manifold X and use H₂(X), or make the presentation APIs genuinely dependent on X. It is forbidden to repair conformance by collapsing H₂(X) back to a single global group such as ℤ.
